description: Erection of a single storey side and rear infill extension to the ground floor flat.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unreferenced Location Plan; Unreferenced Block Plan; LM/SH-001 (Rev A); LM/SH-002 (Rev A); LM/SH-003 (Rev A); LM/SH-004 (Rev B); LM/SH-005 (Rev A); LM/SH-006 (Rev A); LM/SH-007 (Rev A); LM/SH-008 (Rev A); LM/SH-009 (Rev A)  Received:  21 April 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey side and rear infill extensions hereby approved.
